relations.support_notes: Colophon (ID:4481), fol. 82b2:  dbu ma snang ba'i gzhung gi don rigs pa'i tshul dang myi 'gal zhing blo chung bas kyang bde blag du rtogs pa byis pa'i 'jug ngogs (ms: ngos) su sbyar ba rigs par smra ba'i dge slong chos kyi seng ges sbyar ba || rdzogs s+hO ||

comments:
Corresponds to the "Tik+ka" listed A khu ching shes rab rgya mtsho in his Tho yig ([5RXEUKD9]: 522, No. 11318: [phya pa chos seng gi ...] dbu ma snang ba [...gsum] gyi Tik ka).

Commentary on Kamalaśīla's Madhyamakāloka (ID:3734).

This work post-dates Phya pa's dBu ma snying po (ID:4486): Phya pa refers to his own explanation of the five great reasons for proving emptiness in the "de kho na nyid kyi snying po" ((ID:7460), 481-482: 'di rnams kyi don kyi cha ni kho bos de kho na nyid kyi snying por rgya cher gtan la dbab pas 'dir ma spros te | legs par rtogs par 'dod pas de las blta bar bya'o ||) (The passage was identified by Jongbok Yi and is cited in [5ENG67Z7]: 81, n. 9).

The descriptive title given in the colophon "bde blag du rtogs pa byis pa'i 'jug ngogs (ms: ngos) su sbyar ba" resembles that in the conclusive verses of his commentary on the Madhyamakālaṃkāravṛtti (see (ID:4484)): "dbu ma brgyan gyi rtogs sla byis pa'i 'jug ngogs su rnam par phye").
